releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.8 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Strict Zero-Touch Invariant on Inter-Ad Countdown: completely isolates 'Playing next ad in X' countdown sheet to prevent Cancel clicks.
* Ultra-Reliable Screen State Classification: foreground ad dismiss buttons take strict precedence over background navigation tabs.
* Multi-Modal Unified Ad Perception: combines 5-quadrant spatial node analysis, visual canvas frame correlation, and fast-acting dual-corner fallback taps ((8.1%, 6.6%) and (92%, 6.5%)) for stubborn ads.
* Full Modular Componentization: decoupled components for transitions, countdowns, spatial analysis, and classification.
